name: agent-production-readiness
description: Production-readiness checklist v3 scanner, in-place patcher & localhost workbench for Google Cloud AI agents (ADK / google-agents-cli) on Agent Runtime, Cloud Run, and GKE. Only items derived from agent characteristics: persistent sessions & Memory Bank, graceful termination and idle suspend/resume on Agent Substrate (GKE), agents-cli CI/CD pipeline (D1) + eval dataset & score gate (D2), Cloud Trace without prompt capture, authenticated invocation, dedicated agent identity, Agent Registry, Agent Gateway, and AI-generated code isolation (Code Execution · Cloud Run sandboxes · Agent Substrate on GKE). Conditional items apply only when relevant, Preview items never block the verdict, a dependency preflight requires agents-cli >= 1.5.0 + its skills, and general platform best practices are delegated to the Google Cloud platform skills (github.com/google/skills) — strongly recommended to install.
suggestedPrompts: 이 에이전트 프로젝트의 의존성을 점검하고(doctor) 체크리스트 v3로 스캔해서 범주별 결과를 알려줘
Agent Runtime(또는 Cloud Run · GKE) 기준으로 보완 Diff를 보여주고 승인하면 적용한 뒤 READINESS_REPORT.md를 만들어줘
GKE에서 AI 생성 코드 격리(Agent Substrate)와 유휴 에이전트 일시정지·복원이 필요한지 판단하고 적용 방법을 알려줘
